hexudon.title: HEXUDON
hexudon.kinds.hint: Choose each agent's type inside the selection window: 0 = patrol car (collects udon, uses fuel), 1 = refueling car (refills co-located patrol cars). You may resubmit until the window closes. A team that does not choose in time plays with ALL patrol cars — it can still submit every day, but the composition is no longer its own choice.
hexudon.kinds.notOpenYet: The agent-kind window is not open yet — it opens in {time} and closes when Day 1 starts. The picker stays locked until then; it unlocks by itself the moment the window opens.
hexudon.kinds.missed: Your team did not choose its agent kinds inside the selection window, so every car of yours is a patrol car for this match. You still play and submit every day as usual.
hexudon.plan.inputHelp: One array per agent (agent order): 0–5 = move in that direction, a negative number = wait that many steps. Each agent must use exactly {steps} steps.
hexudon.plan.lastValidNote: You may resubmit until the day closes; the last valid submission counts.
hexudon.plan.fuelWarning: Patrol car(s) #{agents} would run out of fuel without a refuel — a refueling car must meet them, or the server will reject the plan.
hexudon.answers.title: Teams' submitted answers
hexudon.answers.empty: No answers visible yet — other teams' answers appear once a day has resolved (or when the game finishes).

questions.boardImmutable: HEXUDON boards cannot be edited in place — delete this question and create a new one to change the board.
questions.selectionHint: s before start, to pick agent kinds
questions.generateHint: Generate a board (or paste an init body in the Manual tab) before saving. The team roster is frozen when the question is created — finalize the match's teams first.
questions.manualHint: Paste the full /game/init JSON body (without game_id). It is validated before being accepted.
questions.resetConfirm: Reset this question? Every team's submitted plans (all days) AND their agent selection will be cleared, so the whole match is played again from the start. This cannot be undone.
questions.resetDone: Question reset — teams can select agents and play again.
questions.autoResetHint:
Every N minutes the question is reset by itself: every team's submitted days are cleared and the match restarts from the agent-kind window, on the same board.

A timed match gets its full agent-kind window back (Day 1 opens one window after each reset). Practice matches restart self-paced. The first reset happens one interval from now, not immediately.
questions.resetPartial: Reset {ok}/{total} team games; some could not be reset.
